note_text:
CC: hallux MTP pain with new midfoot stiffness

HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to multiple painful calluses. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation. PMH: Type 2 diabetes mellitus. Peripheral vascular disease noted.

Exam: plantar callus area consistent with multiple painful calluses. Additional finding: mild tenderness at a separate site.

MDM: addressed an independent problem with risks, data review (X-ray pending), and a management plan distinct from the procedure decision; shared decision making documented.

Procedure: Paring of multiple hyperkeratotic lesions performed (LT and RT modifiers documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
